title: Psalm 75 (Our Thanks We Offer)
lyrics_original: Our thanks we offer, O God
For Your name is upon us.
How Your mercies dwell on us.
Judge all the earth by My promise."
Who dwell in it shall shake now before Me
Quiet your pride now before Me!"
Unto the ends of the earth,
God is the Judge who must humble
His cup of wrath as libation.
But as for me, I will
With singing shall be my endeavor.

bible_verses.english: We give thanks to you, God! We give thanks, for your Name is near. Men tell of your wondrous works.
I will give thanks to Yahweh with my whole heart. I will tell of all your marvelous works.
before Yahweh; for he comes, for he comes to judge the earth. He will judge the world with righteousness, and the peoples with his truth.

devotional.prayer_english: Heavenly Father, we bring You our humble thanks today for Your faithful love and abiding presence. Thank You for bearing Your holy name over our lives and surrounding us with Your tender mercies. When our world trembles, help us trust in Your sovereign timing and righteous promises. May our lives continually testify to Your wonderful works as we rest in Your ultimate salvation. Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: When the world around us feels uncertain or shaken, Psalm 75 invites us to anchor our hearts in God’s unwavering faithfulness. We offer our praise not because our circumstances are perfect, but because His holy name rests upon us and His mercies never fail. In His perfect timing, God will bring true justice and restore all things according to His promises. Today, let us joyfully proclaim His wonderful works and rest securely in His sovereign hands.
